shortfall_reason: No numerical shortfall: 20 distinct metadata concepts, 60 source-claim facts; zero observations, measurements, proposals or media candidates. Thirteen records explicitly enrich 13 unique original brief entries; seven are distinct additions. All 16 original brief entries were compared. Audience profiling, needs formulation, segmentation, journey mapping and COM-B barriers address distinct planning operations rather than label variants; campaign evaluation levels differ from a single message or CTA. Brand appearance timing differs from brand asset restrictions. All titles, summaries, tags and mappings were checked for scope. Broad original guide titles are enrichment anchors, not claims that the sources substantiate every original instruction. No seed ingestion or media acquisition performed; media rights not cleared.
